title: Screen Directors Playhouse
paragraphs: An NBC anthology of radio adaptations of major motion pictures, often featuring stars from the films and appearances or introductions by directors associated with the original productions.
NBC film-adaptation anthology featuring major motion pictures, stars and participation by original film directors. Frozen GRH snapshot contains 119 uniquely numbered broadcasts.

GRH documents the program through NBC Theater / Screen Directors Guild (January 9, 1949 to June 24, 1949) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], Screen Directors Playhouse half-hour (July 1, 1949 to November 2, 1950) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Screen Directors Playhouse hour (November 9, 1950 to September 28, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Jimmy Wallington (announcer on 68 recordings and performer on 1 recording), Howard Wiley (producer on 42 recordings, performer on 10 recordings, and production supervisor on 9 recordings), Bill Cairn (director on 43 recordings, performer on 2 recordings, and producer on 2 recordings), Richard Allen Simmons (radio adaptor on 23 recordings and performer on 4 recordings), Frank Barton (announcer on 19 recordings and performer on 5 recordings), Milton Geiger (radio adaptor on 18 recordings and performer on 2 recordings), and Dan Riss (performer on 19 recordings).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).
Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include romance and relationships, Hollywood film culture, war and military conflict, crime and violence, and western/frontier setting.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (226 shared credited people), [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (93 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (90 shared credited people), [[show|escape|Escape]] (88 shared credited people), and [[show|philip-marlowe|The Adventures of Philip Marlowe]] (77 shared credited people).
